# Arda Karaduman

> arda.tr is the personal catalogue of Arda Karaduman — a Systems Architect and pragmatic programmer in Tokyo, where he has lived since 2004. One flat table of systems, products, games, writing, tools, and music, plus resume, blog, and AI chat.

## Sections

- [Catalogue](https://arda.tr/#catalogue): The full catalogue — systems, products, games, writing, tools, and music in one table
- [Record](https://arda.tr/#record): Career background — Systems Architect at Veltra, Keio University, earlier roles
- [Contact](https://arda.tr/#contact): Email and social links

## Projects

- [Gand](https://gand.tr/): Independent software studio
- [Gand Games](https://gand.games/): The games arm of Gand — the label the games ship under
- [COMMIT!!!](https://commit.gand.tr/): Software-career sim where the legacy monolith is the final boss — out now on Steam and Android
- [Skriv.ist](https://skriv.ist/): Multiplatform ebook reader
- [Fablespun](https://fable.tr/): AI-spun fables — illustrated tales for kids
- [Vigil Today](https://vigil.today/): Smart reminder widget PWA
- [SUDONE](https://sudone.jp/): Scan a shelf barcode in-store and know in seconds if it really beats online prices
- [Pagan](https://pagan.tr/): Turkish black metal band — official site
- [Reliquary](https://github.com/c0ze/reliquary): Self-hosted AI memory server (MCP)
